residualJudgement.why: On this pod the script refuses before picking ('the ephemeral range starts at 16000, leaving no room above 20000'), because 16000 is not above 21000, so a worker pod never picks there. On a default Linux devbox, the gate's band is 1000 of the script's 12768 ports, about 7.8% of its picks. A collision needs a stage script and a go test using Gate running at once, and the pick landing on the gate's port in the seconds that gate is closed: ss sees the port free and the stage process binds it for its run. If that happens, Gate.Open fails the test with EADDRINUSE naming the address. It is loud and it never passes falsely. The one Gate test is TestAFailedReconnectAttemptLogsOneWarnAMinute, and the devbox proofs run one at a time. If it ever matters, the same fix fits there: free-port.sh can stop 1000 below the low bound.
